entries.label: H1 text
entries.original: Integrated Heart & Vitality Coaching is offered to support your individuation journey.
entries.value: Integrated Heart & Vitality Coaching is offered to support your individuation journey.

entries.label: P text
entries.original: Growth and Vitality which includes the Heart, is about seeing with compassion and honesty to the deepest layers of our Self.
entries.value: Growth and Vitality which includes the Heart, is about seeing with compassion and honesty to the deepest layers of our Self.

entries.label: P text
entries.original: Our wholeness, must be guided by our greater awareness of Self. Integrating this intention into our work sets us up for ongoing success and wellness in life. Most doctors and coaches do no have the patience for this, the time, or training. And that's where this coaching approach differs from most of what you'll see.

Most doctors and coaches do no have the patience for this, the time, or training. And that's where this coaching approach differs from most of what you'll see.

entries.label: H2 text
entries.original: A healthier heart and life asks more of us that surface fixes.
entries.value: A healthier heart and life asks more of us that surface fixes.

entries.label: P text
entries.original: The holistic journey to health and happiness is what our predecessors sought and taught, but we have lost that way. Even Hippocrates was a Holistic, but we have moved very far away from Holistic Health & Wellness. This work is rooted in the belief that people become whole through integration and untangling the full (very complex!) human.
entries.value: The holistic journey to health and happiness is what our predecessors sought and taught, but we have lost that way. Even Hippocrates was a Holistic, but we have moved very far away from Holistic Health & Wellness. This work is rooted in the belief that people become whole through integration and untangling the full (very complex!) human.

entries.label: P text
entries.original: Your wholeness is my purpose and goal. And for that, you need a working understanding of your Heart.
entries.value: Your wholeness is my purpose and goal. And for that, you need a working understanding of your Heart.

entries.label: BLOCKQUOTE text
entries.original: Broken hearts don't work. So what do we do? We fix them.
entries.value: Broken hearts don't work. So what do we do? We fix them.

entries.label: P text
entries.original: To work at a deep level, we must work and understand the world of archetypes. In work with Men, the Masculine Heart archetype is the development of mature masculinity. The concept develops the hearts of men, and is a medicine of it's own kind.
entries.value: To work at a deep level, we must work and understand the world of archetypes. In work with Men, the Masculine Heart archetype is the development of mature masculinity. The concept develops the hearts of men, and is a medicine of it's own kind.

entries.label: P text
entries.original: Feeling good in the body cannot be underestimated. Through natural methods, and mindful movement, both ancient and scientifically backed, we support the bodies innate wisdom to heal and thrive. This is core to our coaching work together.
entries.value: Feeling good in the body cannot be underestimated. Through natural methods, and mindful movement, both ancient and scientifically backed, we support the bodies innate wisdom to heal and thrive. This is core to our coaching work together.

entries.label: P text
entries.original: Cultivating states of mind is necessary for growth and a healthy life. Qi Gong, and other aspects of meditation and awareness as principle tools used in the coaching journey.
entries.value: Cultivating states of mind is necessary for growth and a healthy life. Qi Gong, and other aspects of meditation and awareness as principle tools used in the coaching journey.

entries.label: P text
entries.original: Most of us in modern culture think we are dealing with emotions when we are really just pushing them away. A piece of this work is emotional alchemy — learning how to truly shift emotional states instead of suppressing them.

entries.label: P text
entries.original: Emotional literacy and energy literacy are paramount for our growth and evolution. We'll work on these too.
entries.value: Emotional literacy and energy literacy are paramount for our growth and evolution. We'll work on these too.

entries.label: P text
entries.original: I find it very likely, that when we reference the power of the Human Heart, it is analogous to our sub-conscious Mind, and leads to a certain quality of intuition. The sub-conscious processes a billion times more information than the conscious mind... Thus we must clear our internal lens, and learn to access the Heart and the wealth of utility that is there.

entries.original: For some of our indigenous ancestors, a man connecting to his heart was part of his rite of passage into manhood. This work draws from that deeper remembering while also using modern tools, insight, and practice. The aim is not performance for its own sake, but a fuller, steadier, and more whole life.
